reasons: The verdict (Delayed badge, clock mark, plain sentence, next step) sits near the top of the phone layout, above the metadata and the raw events. Every time ends in UTC. The page does not promise a retry or give a next-try time, and the wording is calm and uses the product's own words. Deferred appears only as an event name, which is allowed.
